Package com.example.tarecruitment

package com.example.tarecruitment
TA Hiring System backend main package.

The project adopts a lightweight teaching architecture with Servlet, JSP, native JavaScript, CSS, and CSV. Business code is organized by domain packages, public capabilities are placed in the common package, and demo data initialization is placed in the demo package.
